Full summary: Session wrap: housekeeping executed on the beta server — 247 blackboard entries archived (incl. 130 duplicates), 2 orphaned graph entities pruned, 249 record files deleted from the export tree. First real housekeeping run through 2.0.0-beta.1 on live state: clean, another soak datapoint.
Findings: Housekeeping preview/execute asymmetry worth remembering: preview reported 'remove 130 duplicates' but execute reported dedupe 0 and archive 247 — the archive pass swept the duplicates, so the two summaries describe the same work differently. Not a bug, but the preview undersells how much the archive pass will move.; The dangling warning about package-lock.json's stale top-level version field (01KWK9KV65) is now resolved in practice — npm version 2.0.0-beta.1 rewrote it this session.
